================================================================================
Date and timestamp literals
================================================================================

SELECT DATE '2026-10-31', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 10:00:00.5', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 10:00:00 -08:00' FROM dual;

================================================================================
Interval literals
================================================================================

SELECT INTERVAL '1' DAY, INTERVAL '1-2' YEAR TO MONTH, INTERVAL '4 5:12' DAY TO MINUTE, INTERVAL '400' DAY(3), INTERVAL '30.12345' SECOND(2, 4) FROM dual;

---

(source_file
  (select_statement
    (select
      (typed_literal
        (type)
        (string)
        (interval_qualifier))
      (typed_literal
        (type)
        (string)
        (interval_qualifier))
      (typed_literal
        (type)
        (string)
        (interval_qualifier))
      (typed_literal
        (type)
        (string)
        (interval_qualifier
          (type_modifiers
            (number))))
      (typed_literal
        (type)
        (string)
        (interval_qualifier
          (type_modifiers
            (number)
            (number))))
      (from_clause
        (table_reference
          (object_reference
            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
A column named timestamp
================================================================================

SELECT timestamp, interval FROM t;
